name: smwgraphics-mega-man-x2-early-prototype-x-hunter-base
title: Mega Man X2 (Early Prototype) - X-Hunter Base 3
description:
A bright mechanized background with three repeated lightbeams seeing in the early prototype of Mega Man X2.

There are two versions:
- One that normally appears in the game;
- A centered version that makes the three lightbeams stay in the middle (at the cost of using more map 16 tiles);
